correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the complete product decomposition in the nonmodular prime-order case, the full base-field algebra automorphism group, the precise orbit data, and the multiplication-characteristic-polynomial factorization. In the nonsplit case, exponents of nonlinear irreducibles recover Frobenius-orbit multiplicities, while exponents of linear factors modulo the common degree recover the distinguished scalar coordinate. Burnside counting then gives the stated element and unit formulas. The packaged finite-field checker independently exhausts several split and nonsplit cases; it is corroborative rather than the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The equivalence relation is the natural full algebra-automorphism action on a classical finite group algebra. The result gives an intrinsic, computable complete invariant rather than merely a numerical census, and the exact orbit formulas work uniformly for every prime order and every nonmodular finite coefficient field. The split/nonsplit arithmetic is controlled transparently by the multiplicative order of the field size modulo the group order.
